restaurantName: Yi Pin Wei Braised Duck．Kway Chap
address: Tampines Round Market & Food Centre, #01-40, 137 Tampines Street 11, 521137, Singapore
bio: In addition to their signature braised duck, they also serve pork trotter and chitterlings. The kway chap set menu enables you to sample different cuts all at once in a mild herbal broth. The stall also features rice dishes and kway teow....
